easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Doc Samson.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Doc Samson, Super Psychiatrist
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater
